soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.60–0.62, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broad and rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, a slight depression between the two ridges. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent region at its apex needle-like and pointed, with both apical and subapical hairs. The mandibles are strong, their apices rather curved, the mandibular condyle visible; the mandibular length 0.57–0.59 times the head capsule length and 0.98–1.00 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the waist region slender and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.28–0.31. The pronotum is nearly trapezoidal, about 1.62–1.68 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the median notch of the anterior margin deeper than that of the posterior, with four to six hairs in the middle region.
